headlines.title: Army set to detonate a cache of lead explosives, sending toxic plume across Iowa
headlines.description: The Army plans to detonate a stockpile of unstable lead azide explosives in Iowa on Wednesday morning. The toxic dust plume is expected to travel for miles.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff, saying he went ‘too far’ and is in therapy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made a triumphant return to the semiconductor giant in an all-hands meeting Tuesday morning, apologizing to staff for his conduct during his previous stint at the company’s helm and vowing to do better this time around.

headlines.title: Trump says pardon is always an option for Huang, and that invoking the Fifth isn’t necessary
headlines.description: The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week.

headlines.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia lands in Spain a ‘free man’ after deportation battle
headlines.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has landed in Spain after leaving the United States at the end of a closely watched and controversial deportation battle that became a symbol for the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

headlines.title: New travel headache as storms threaten both coasts
headlines.description: The FAA issued a ground stop for a time today at Chicago’s O’Hare Airport. A series of storms is bearing down on the West, while high winds could ground balloons at the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: 2 men charged with burglary after break-in at Prince William and Princess Kate’s country home
headlines.description: Two men have been charged in connection with a burglary at the Sandringham estate, police said, after a reported break-in at the home of Prince William and Kate.

headlines.title: Fort Hood mass shooter makes legal move to stop Pentagon’s firing squad execution
headlines.description: The former Army officer whose scheduled military execution by firing squad provoked outrage over an initial proposal to livestream his death is planning to file a constitutional challenge that could halt his December execution, his lawyers said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Black Friday deals are already here, and I’m tracking the best ones live: Walmart, Apple, PlayStation and more
headlines.description: These Black Friday deals are already live, and our shopping experts found the best ones to grab. Find sales from Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target and more up to 70% off.

headlines.title: How are you affording the holidays?
headlines.description: After a year of high gas prices, inflation ticking back up and a lot of Americans feeling pessimistic about the economy, we want to know how people are affording the annual wave of holiday gifts, travel and entertainment costs.

headlines.title: Too young to be vaccinated for measles? Babies face growing threats from outbreaks
headlines.description: As measles outbreaks continue to soar, a new question has emerged: Should doctors give measles shots earlier to better protect babies?

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Iowans prepare for toxic lead detonation and experts criticize Trump’s role in Huang’s return: Morning Rundown
headlines.description: The Army is set to detonate an estimated 9,700 pounds of lead azide in Iowa.
